```yaml
  namespace: analytics
roleRef:

  name: secret-reader

```

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Tests hands-on ability to apply Kubernetes NetworkPolicy for multi-namespace isolation and least privilege, including default-deny and per-port allow rules, plus practical troubleshooting steps.

## Key Concepts
- NetworkPolicy basics
- namespaceSelector and podSelector
- Ingress vs Egress rules and reciprocity
- Troubleshooting pod reachability with test pods

## Code Example
```yaml
# api-prod-default-deny
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: api-prod-default-deny
  namespace: api-prod
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: api-prod
  policyTypes:
  - Ingress
  - Egress
```

```yaml
# api-prod-to-logging (allow egress to logging)
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: api-prod-to-logging
  namespace: api-prod
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: api-prod
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          name: logging
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 8080
```

```yaml
# logging-accept-api-prod (allow ingress from api-prod to logging)
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: logging-accept-api-prod
  namespace: logging
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: logging
  policyTypes:
  - Ingress
  ingress:
  - from:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          name: api-prod
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 8080
```

```yaml
# api-prod-to-db (allow egress to db-prod on 5432)
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: api-prod-to-db
  namespace: api-prod
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: api-prod
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          name: db-prod
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 5432
```

```yaml
# db-accept-api-prod (allow ingress from api-prod to db)
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: db-accept-api-prod
  namespace: db-prod
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: db
  policyTypes:
  - Ingress
  ingress:
  - from:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          name: api-prod
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 5432
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you verify no other cross-namespace traffic is allowed after policies apply?
- How would you roll back if a required path is blocked by policy?
